New module pp-nav-context-v1.js v1.0.0 verified additive — no changes to brand-portal, wallet, feedtabs, onboarding. ZIP MD5 matches d42fb737ea0ae065ffcac66e1b232852. Backend /api/downloads endpoint returns 200 + application/zip + 4026558 bytes. Added 26 new assertions covering all 11 static-audit acceptance criteria from the master prompt.
critical_code_review_comments: pp-nav-context-v1.js IIFE-wrapped, idempotent via __ppNavContextInit, exposes clean public API (openMerken, resolveBackRoute, brandLogoFor, injectLogos, VERSION). Pattern mirrors v60.1.159 PP_Wallet.openWallet bypass — consistent with codebase conventions.

Capture-phase delegator (3rd arg true on document.addEventListener) correctly pre-empts brand-portal _renderLock absorption before inline onclick=DY.navigeer('merken') fires. preventDefault + stopPropagation guarantee single execution path.
openMerken() defensively wraps each DY mutation in try/catch and pushes ?pagina=merken with id deleted via history.pushState — correct for SPA URL hygiene.
brandLogoFor() caches BOTH success and failure (url:null), preventing repeated Firestore reads for brands without logos. 5-min TTL is reasonable for brand-logo data.
patchUitgelichtCards regex /openCamp\('[^']*','([^']*)'/ correctly extracts brandId without modifying pp-feedtabs source — clean separation of concerns.

MutationObserver observes document.body with childList+subtree — broad scope is acceptable here since the cost (patchUitgelichtCards + injectLogos) is dominated by data-pp-* guard attributes. Suggest debouncing in a future iteration if profiler shows hotspots.

MINOR (not blocking): The MutationObserver fires patchUitgelichtCards + injectLogos on every DOM mutation; consider rAF-debouncing in a future revision if performance regressions show up under high-frequency rerenders.
MINOR (not blocking): brandLogoFor reads brands/{brandId}.logo but does not validate it's a URL string — relies on the type-check `typeof data.logo === 'string'`. OK for trusted Firestore data.

rca of the issue: N/A — this is a feature-addition iteration verification, not a bug-fix RCA. The original user-reported issue ('Terug naar merken viel terug naar /feed') is structurally addressed by the capture-phase delegator: brand-portal's inline onclick=DY.navigeer('merken') was being absorbed by _renderLock guards inside renderMerken(); the new pp-nav-context delegator runs FIRST (capture phase), clears _renderLock + _laatstGerenderd, then calls renderMerken() directly — bypassing the absorption. The brand-logo initials problem is addressed by the MutationObserver-driven post-render patcher that injects data-brand-id from openCamp() onclick handlers and replaces .pp-uitg-logo innerHTML with real tags fetched (and cached for 5 min) from brands/{uid}.logo.
